label: Multichannel listening room B5-108, Aalborg University
note: Box-shaped, symmetrical listening room (paper Sec. 2.1: 60 m2, reverberation time adjustable between about 0.2 and 0.4 s; the SMARD website gives about 0.15 s for the campaign, measured with a B&K 2270; RIRDB measures 0.16 s at mid frequencies); the carpet was removed for the campaign (wooden floor); 20.2-21.2 C. Size from setup.txt (width x length x height); volume from it. Source A_B = loudspeaker (0 OmniPower 4296, 1 OmniSource 4295, 2 directional 3-inch) and its position (0: about (2.0, 6.5, 1.3) m facing -90 deg, 1: about (3.5, 4.5, 1.9) m facing -45 deg); setup.txt places the OmniPower 4296 0.37 m further along its axis and 0.1 m lower in the ULA and UCA sessions (21 and 27 Jan) than in the orthogonal-array session (14 Jan). Receiver CD_array = array set-up and position (Table 2) and the array: orth (21 G.R.A.S. 40AZ mics, three orthogonal 7-mic arms, roles 1X-7Z), single_mic, ULA_A/B/C (7 mics, 5 cm), UCA_A (6 mics, radius 4 cm), UCA_B (6 mics, radius 6 cm). The IRs are the authors' estimates from the recordings.
